notes.title: Fomon entering Early Access! What now!?
notes.content:
[b]At long last, Fomon has entered Early Access![/b]
That means the real game is playable with a bunch more features than the demo.

First and foremost, we got the [b]inventory[/b] system live and kicking! Every card you get is put in your inventory. The cards you get are the cards you play with. Every 1h of playtime rewards you with a new random card.

[b]Achievements[/b] are live, and a short questline is built around these. Unlocking them grants bonus drops—sometimes even booster packs to get you going.

[b]Forging[/b] duplicates into better cards is now possible! Click two duplicates and click Forge—this will trigger an AMAZING loading screen. Since everything is handled via the Steam inventory service, your client has to wait until Steam has figured their stuff out and exchanged your cards for a new one.
And yes, you can forge two Tier 1 and continue forging even after that, good luck!

The same goes for [b]opening[/b] a booster pack—an AMAZING loading screen pops up while opening the pack. The booster gives you 4 totally random rarity cards and 1 rare or better card.

[b]Demo Rewards Program[/b] will be live for a bit longer:
[list]
[*] Owning the demo gives you one bonus card.
[*] Playing the demo for at least 15 minutes gives you one bonus card.
[*] Playing the demo for at least 1 hour gives you one booster pack.
[*] The "Reaching Top 5 ATH" event is finished, and the winners are:
[b]zitrx3nchen[/b] - 86 spree
[b]Antchain[/b] - 70 spree
[b]Kaladin[/b] - 57 spree
[b]Zafir[/b] - 51 spree
[b]Atlas[/b] - 51 spree

Very good job! I've sent a friend request to all of you to personally hand over your prize!
[/list]

Lastly, thank you all for the amazing support during the Steam Next Fest! We reached 700 wishlists and 400 unique players played the demo, with an average playtime of 30 minutes!!! I am overwhelmed!
Thank you all! 

Now the real journey begins—more [b]achievements[/b], more quests, more features!

notes.title: Leaderboard update frequency
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193083/09afb5a5d5283db407cf466b6960598d4d7ed228.png[/img]

I see some people are REALLY crushing it out there. Good job! 
I never got over 20 myself and I see people in the 40+ and 50+ sprees now. BOOM!

BUT I also saw some sad faces when someone broke their best spree and didn't see it in represented in the in-game leaderboard. So I have to address this:

Your score is pushed to the leaderboard every 2.5 minutes due to Steamworks leaderboard limitations.
I also save ONE LAST push to when the application is exited, pushing the current best spree to the leaderboard again, just so no score is missed.

[b]But in essence, just wait max 2.5 min, and your score should update.[/b]

I'll fix this during the demo week. Possibly by removing the "live leaderboard" since it doesn't really fill any purpose when unlimited leaderboard updates are not allowed from Steamworks/Steam.

notes.title: EA.0.0.10
notes.content:
Time to log some development!

What has happened:
[list]
[*] The extremely buggy forging feature, along with the new open pack features gotten a facelift. The freature now triggers a "progress screen" hindering other actions while the opening/forging is in progress.  It was not that the feature didn't work before, but the responsiveness and UX was terrible. Now clicking Open or Forge immediately gives a response. 
[*] Foundations for new achievements laid. Will revolve around collecting unique and battling/beating unique Fomon. Will be implemented soon.
[*] Launch data postponed to match the next "Steam Next Fest".
[/list]


What is coming next:
[list]
[*] SFX + background music in development now, finally! 
[*] Playable Demo is development. Will not revolve around the collection of Fomon but rather let you test the in game features, like battle... well.. mainly battle.
[/list]
